Confirmed, but blocked by platform-security design: current firmware persists secret_key into default NVS while CONFIG_NVS_ENCRYPTION and flash encryption are disabled, and the repo has no nvs_keys partition. A real fix requires coordinated NVS-encryption / key-protection / partition / provisioning changes, not a safe one-bug firmware patch.

Confirmed, but blocked by cross-stack provisioning design: BLE Wi-Fi provisioning currently uses plain writable/notifiable GATT characteristics with no pairing, bonding, MITM, or encrypted/authenticated characteristic flags. A real fix changes the mobile provisioning flow and app UX, not just firmware internals.

Confirmed, but blocked by intentional provisioning design: current repo docs explicitly define local plain HTTP as the one-time trust channel for delivering MQTT credentials after BLE/Wi-Fi bootstrap. Changing that requires coordinated app, firmware, and trust-bootstrap redesign rather than a safe one-bug firmware patch.
